description:
Manage email credential setup and runtime configuration.

Setup actions (credential lifecycle):
- status: Show current credential state and configured accounts
- setup_status: Show credential state only (no accounts list; cross-server parity action)
- setup_start: Show how to supply credentials (EMAIL_CREDENTIALS env var or `email auth` CLI)
- setup_reset: Clear stored credentials and reset to awaiting_setup state
- setup_complete: Re-check credential state after credentials were supplied

Runtime actions:
- set: Update runtime settings (email has no runtime settings; returns ok=false)
- cache_clear: Clear IMAP folder caches and the OAuth token cache
name: config
